title: Weekly Email Digest Notification Preferences
purpose: Document member-controlled weekly email digest notification preferences, persistence after sign-out and sign-in, separation from account-security messages, and default state for new members.

scope.text: Members can change weekly email digest notification settings, the preference persists across sessions, account-security messages remain unaffected, and new members start with weekly digests off.

requirements.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

stories.text: As a member, I want to switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings, with the setting persisting after sign-out and sign-in, without disabling account-security messages; newly created members start with weekly digests off.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in member viewing notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests on, then the setting changes to on.
Given a signed-in member viewing notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests off, then the setting changes to off.
Given a member has selected a weekly digest preference, when the member signs out and then signs back in, then the preference remains unchanged.
Given weekly email digests are switched off for a member, when an account-security message is triggered, then the account-security message is still delivered.
Given a newly created member, when the member views notification settings, then weekly email digests are off by default.

dependencies.text: Owner and delivery date are unknown.

success_metrics.text: A tester can observe the selected weekly digest preference persisting after sign-out and sign-in.

open_questions: Who is the owner of this feature?
